= table-combined-span-formatting(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2025-01-20
:span-name: Ada

== Name

table-combined-span-formatting - test combined table span formatting

== Synopsis

*table-combined-span-formatting*

== Description

=== Column defaults

.Defaults follow source cells
[cols=">.>s,<.<e,^.^h"]
|===
2.2+^.^e|Combined *bold* {span-name}
|First companion *bold* {span-name}
|Second companion _italic_ {span-name}
|First *bold*
|Second *bold*
|Third _italic_
|===

.Duplicates use each column
[cols=">.>s,<.<e,^.^h"]
|===
3*|Repeated *bold* {span-name}
|===

=== Explicit span formats

[cols="3*"]
|===
2.2+<.<s|Strong _italic_
|Beside strong
|Below strong
2.2+^.^e|Emphasis *bold*
|Beside emphasis
|Below emphasis
2.2+>.>h|Header _italic_
|Beside header
|Below header
2.2+^.<l|Literal *bold* {span-name}
|Beside literal
|Below literal
2.2+>.^m|Monospace *bold* {span-name}
|Beside monospace
|Below monospace
|===

=== AsciiDoc span

[cols="3*"]
|===
2.2+>.>a|
Paragraph in a combined cell.

* Nested item one
* Nested item two
|Beside AsciiDoc
|Below AsciiDoc
|===
